question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant that comes up heading toward Oak Grove Farm, Millis, MA from Wernick Farm Reserve, Dartmouth, MA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Wernick Farm Reserve%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Oak Grove Farm%' LIMIT 1 ), path_segment AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point s, end_point e, path_segment ps WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ps.geom::geography, 5000) -- within 5km of the direct path AND ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) < ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, e.geometry::geography) -- ensure it's not past the destination ORDER BY ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) LIMIT 1;
